counts_note: Declared in the engine headers under src/game/. creatures = kill-type categories (proto_types.h:101-117). classes = 0 (no class enum in the engine; archetype shapes are 7 primary stats, 18 skills, 16 traits, 64 perks). weapons = 13 ammo calibers (proto_types.h:70-86); the weapon instances are in the data pack. gear_sets = 0 (no set-bonus code found). zones = 4 world terrains (worldmap.h:107-110). classes: No class enum in the engine. Progression shape: 7 primary stats (stat_defs.h:64), 18 skills with 3 tagged at start (skill_defs.h:9, :31), 16 traits (trait.h:29), 64 perks (perk_defs.h:7-70). Tag-skill effects are in skill.cc, not read.
2 human race variants and 2 genders (proto_types.h:20-24, :88-92). Race is a look, not a class.
weapon_families: 13 ammo calibers plus none: rocket, flamethrower fuel, two energy-cell tiers, rifle, pistol and shotgun calibers (proto_types.h:70-86)
7 damage types: normal, laser, fire, plasma, electrical, EMP, explosion (proto_types.h:59-68)
4 attack modes plus none: unarmed, melee, throw, ranged (item.h:11-17)
about 20 melee and unarmed hit modes in punch and kick ladders (combat_defs.h, HIT_MODE_* near lines 40-66)
gear_tiers: armour is an item type (proto_types.h:26-34), no set bonuses found
8 material types: glass, metal, plastic, wood, dirt, stone, cement, leather (proto_types.h:47-57)
power armour as a special item ID (proto_types.h:121)
per-item stats and looks are in the data pack, not read
zones: 4 world terrains: desert, mountain, city, coast (worldmap.h:107-110)
random encounter table indexed by world position (worldmap.cc:2099; table not read)
elevator IDs grouped by location, including two glow elevators (elevator.h:6; elevator.cc:78-79)
radiation levels from mild to fatal, 8 radiation effects (critter.h:18, :36-44; critter.cc:58, :77)
dungeon archetypes are in map data files, not read
